File: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
Line or code reference: 8983-8995
Problem: Cache-miss or malformed GraphQL `head.sha` is embedded in `_STD_ITER_PR_JSON_CACHED` without sanitization; downstream non-retry fast path consumes the cache, and a transient failure could leave a blank, `"null"`, or invalid SHA that lets an empty-commit push race an in-flight `workflow_dispatch` review run.
Why it fails at runtime: A `/pulls/{n}` refetch failure (rate-limit transient or API error) could leave partial state that short-circuits the empty-commit guard if the cached-PR "head.sha" is not empty/"null".
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3

File: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
Line or code reference: 10551-10557
Problem: `jq -cn … --arg hs "${_std_cached_head_sha}"` appends `sha: ""` or `sha: null` when `_std_cached_head_sha` is empty (via the `+ (if $hs != "" …)` pattern), which can create invalid JSON bytes (`"sha": ""`) that are blindly passed downstream; while `echo ""` fallback to empty is benign in the shell context, if any prior collector supplied an empty string, `_STD_ITER_PR_JSON_CACHED` would contain `"head": {"ref":"", "sha":""}` (or similar malformed key/value), which is then interpolated in retrigger calls and could confuse review-guard matching on invalid payloads.
Why it fails at runtime: malformed json payloads could misroute in-flight review detection.
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
